```html
<div class="container mx-auto py-12">
    <h1 class="text-center text-3xl font-bold mb-8">Contact Us</h1>
    @if ($errors->any())
        <div class="bg-red-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-md mt-4" role="alert">
            <ul>
                @foreach ($errors as $error)
                    <li>{{ $error }}</li>
                @endforeach
            </ul>
        </div>
    @endif

    <form wire:submit.prevent="submitForm">
        <div class="mb-6">
            <label for="name" class="block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2">{{ __('Name') }}</label>
            <input type="text" id="name" wire:model="formData.name" class="shadow appearance-none border rounded-md w-full py-2 px-3 leading-tight focus:outline-none focus:shadow-outline">
        </div>
        <div class="mb-6">
            <label for="email" class="block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2">{{ __('Email') }}</label>
            <input type="text" id="email" wire:model="formData.email" class="shadow appearance-none border rounded-md w-full py-2 px-3 leading-tight focus:outline-none focus:shadow-outline">
        </div>
        <div class="mb-6">
            <label for="message" class="block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2">{{ __('Message') }}</label>
            <textarea id="message" wire:model="formData.message" class="shadow appearance-none border rounded-md w-full py-2 px-3 leading-tight focus:outline-none focus:shadow-outline"></textarea>
        </div>
        <button type="submit" class="bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded-md hover:bg-blue-700">Submit</button>
    </form>
</div>
```
